title: Lightroom vs Photoshop Editing – Day 29 (PHLEARN)

locations.name: Mongolia
locations.basis: Explicit statement in transcript: 'Cuz these were taken in Mongolia.'

summary: PHLEARN’s Day 29 lesson contrasts Lightroom’s batch editing, organization, and cloud-style workflow with Photoshop’s single-image, layer-based editing. The video demonstrates a practical end-to-end workflow: importing a batch of sample images into Lightroom Classic, organizing with catalogs and metadata, rating and filtering to identify favorites, renaming and foldering to mirror the file system, syncing edits across multiple photos, and performing a color-grade pass. It then transitions to Photoshop to perform a sky replacement on a single image, showing layer-based editing, masking, and export of a PSD back into Lightroom. The session emphasizes how Lightroom handles mass photo management and bulk edits while Photoshop handles targeted, composite edits and final fine-tuning.”
